scope: Specification obligations; descriptive fields are not product wire DTOs.

cases.given: Recognised Decision BOM; authentic signature; independently pinned receipt public key; all applicable evidence agrees.
cases.expected: Body signature valid; this does not assert all sections valid.

cases.given: S01; original signature retained.
cases.operation: Flip one byte of the signed body.
cases.expected: Body signature invalid or structural refusal.

cases.given: A correctly signed receipt payload.
cases.operation: Present its bytes and signature as a Decision BOM.
cases.expected: Refuse receipt v as unknown BOM v; never valid BOM.

cases.given: Body signed by a trusted key with an unknown v.
cases.expected: Refuse unknown v even though primitive signature is valid.

cases.given: Independent trust root A.
cases.operation: Replace body and bundle keys with fresh key B and re-sign both with B.
cases.expected: Invalid or refused; self-consistent embedded key never becomes authority.

cases.given: Historic body signed by A; deployment now signs with B; A remains independently pinned.
cases.operation: Verify historic body with no private key.
cases.expected: Body signature valid; rotation or retirement alone does not invalidate history.

cases.given: Authentic body and bundled public key, no supplied trust root.
cases.expected: Refuse verification; never trust embedded key alone.

cases.given: Canonical receipt payload and signature authentic under independently pinned receipt key A; matching payload hash.
cases.expected: Receipt signature and payload hash valid.

cases.given: Receipt from S08; body is freshly validly signed after mutation.
cases.operation: Change receipt payload bytes but retain receipt signature.
cases.expected: Receipt signature invalid; outer/body authenticity cannot repair receipt.

cases.given: Receipt authentic under independently pinned A; body freshly signed after mutation.
cases.expected: Receipt payload-hash binding invalid.

cases.given: Receipt signed by A; independent keyring binds declared receipt key id to B.
cases.expected: Receipt signature invalid; never choose a different bundled key to repair declared binding.

cases.given: Receipt signed under an unpinned key; body valid under a separately trusted key.
cases.expected: Receipt signature cannot be accepted from bundled key alone; invalid or refused.

cases.given: v2 receipt commits SHA-256 of the exact canonical facts.payload bytes.
cases.expected: Receipt-to-facts binding valid when digests equal.

cases.given: F01; body freshly signed after mutation.
cases.operation: Swap facts.payload from another decision without replacing receipt.
cases.expected: Receipt-to-facts binding invalid.

cases.given: Receipt and payload digest authentic; sections were projected from payload.
cases.operation: Change any action/policy/model/approval/outcome/cost/trace/actors section and re-sign BOM.
cases.expected: Projection binding invalid for each changed section; body signature valid is insufficient.

cases.given: Audit seq at or above independently trusted v2 boundary; v2 receipt has missing factsHash without capture_off.
cases.expected: Invalid; do not downgrade to unverifiable.

cases.given: Audit seq at or above v2 boundary; signed v2 payload has factsHash null and factsStatus capture_off; decision-time marker agrees.
cases.expected: Honest capture_off limit; affected sections not_recorded forever.

cases.given: Audit seq at or above v2 boundary; null factsHash but capture-off only claimed outside signed receipt.
cases.expected: Invalid; external current setting cannot justify null signed commitment.

cases.given: Audit seq below boundary; authentic v1 receipt; exact captured facts and valid addenda.
cases.expected: unverifiable, reason receipt_v1_no_factsHash; cannotProve facts were recorded at decision time.

cases.given: Audit seq exactly equal to from_audit_seq; otherwise authentic v1 receipt.
cases.expected: Invalid; equality belongs to v2 boundary.

cases.given: Audit seq below from_audit_seq; signing sweep runs after cutover.
cases.expected: v1 receipt; signing time does not move pre-boundary audit row into v2.

cases.given: Authentic facts digest H0 and signed addenda 1,2 with prev_hash H0,H1 respectively.
cases.operation: Verify each exact payload, signature and links.
cases.expected: Addendum chain valid.

cases.given: F10; body freshly signed after mutation.
cases.expected: Invalid gap; n begins at1 and increments without forks.

cases.given: F10; body freshly signed after mutation.
cases.expected: Invalid addendum chain even if its signature is freshly valid.

cases.given: Exact addendum payload present; BOM signature valid.
cases.expected: Invalid addendum signature.

cases.given: AI native body and signatures authentic; rendering SHA-256 and byte length committed inside signed native body.
cases.operation: Verify rendering file against native commitment.
cases.expected: Rendering binding valid if both digest and byte length equal.

cases.given: Rendering is listed and hashed in an authentic outer manifest; signed native body contains no hash for it.
cases.expected: Rendering invalid; outer signature alone never authenticates rendering.

cases.given: R01; outer manifest freshly re-signed after file mutation; native body unchanged.
cases.expected: Rendering invalid against native hash.

cases.given: R01; digest matches signed value but signed byte length differs.
cases.expected: Rendering invalid; matching SHA-256 alone is insufficient.

cases.given: Bare CycloneDX or SPDX rendering requested through format download.
cases.expected: Deliver export-bundle/3 with signed native body and signature; never bare rendering bytes.

cases.given: Frozen old snapshot lacks a newly added renderer.
cases.operation: Request new format for old snapshot.
cases.expected: 404 format_not_rendered_for_snapshot with available formats; no backfill.

cases.given: Model missing supplier releaseTime or downloadLocation.
cases.expected: No SPDX rendering; signed native body records spdx-3.0.1 not_producible with missing names; incomplete; CycloneDX unaffected.

cases.given: Receipt signed; covering anchor not flushed; strict anchored setting.
cases.expected: 409 bom_anchor_pending with Retry-After; no frozen row.

cases.given: Receipt signed; covering anchor flushed; tamper-resistance observation false; strict setting.
cases.expected: 409 bom_anchor_pending, destination_not_tamper_resistant; no frozen row.

cases.given: Receipt and all addenda signed; anchor covering decision flushed; observation true; retain_until equals evidence-retention end; required timestamp verified.
cases.expected: Freeze anchored; equality satisfies retention coverage.

cases.given: Receipt and all addenda signed; flushed covering anchor observation false; audited anchored_unverified_destination relaxation; timestamps not required.
cases.expected: Freeze anchored_unverified_destination; signed observation false; report recorded observation limit.

cases.given: Receipt and all addenda signed; no anchor; audited chain_signed relaxation.
cases.expected: Freeze chain_signed with proof.anchor absent; never report anchored.

cases.given: Otherwise L03 but timestamp mode required and token absent.
cases.expected: 409 bom_anchor_pending; flushed tamper-resistant destination alone is insufficient.

cases.given: Receipt and anchor ready; existing addendum unsigned; signing key present.
cases.expected: 409 bom_anchor_pending; unsigned addendum neither dropped nor frozen not_recorded.

cases.given: Existing unsigned addendum and no signing key.
cases.expected: 409 bom_signing_unavailable; no unsigned fallback.

cases.given: Already frozen authentic bytes; no private signing key.
cases.operation: Read frozen bytes and verify with pinned public key.
cases.expected: Read and verification remain available; building newly signed outer bundle is a separate key-dependent operation.

cases.given: Frozen version1; current policy, grants, model card and prompt change.
cases.expected: Return byte-identical stored body/hash/signature; no live historical reads or re-render.

cases.given: Version1 frozen; a later fact or timestamp becomes available.
cases.expected: Version2 supersedes version1; earlier bytes remain unchanged.

cases.given: Late-fact transaction commits before locked final addendum recheck.
cases.expected: Include signed late fact or wait for signature; never omit it.

cases.given: Late-fact transaction commits after frozen insert.
cases.expected: New version with supersedes; immutable earlier version.

cases.given: Two concurrent first requests for a decision with no facts row.
cases.operation: Freeze using capture-status-row lock, or audit-id advisory lock for pre-marker decision.
cases.expected: Return same frozen BOM/version; no concurrent fork.

cases.given: Either B4 or B5 has not shipped.
cases.operation: Request AI snapshot or run automatic trigger.
cases.expected: Snapshot route501 bom_snapshots_not_released; triggers do nothing; no admin override.

cases.given: All finality evidence valid.
cases.expected: anchored > anchored_unverified_destination > chain_signed; policy admits only evidence at least as strong as required setting.

cases.given: Flushed true observation; retain_until one millisecond before evidence-retention end.
cases.expected: Cannot freeze anchored; at most anchored_unverified_destination under audited relaxation.

cases.given: Frozen anchored body; verification time after retain_until.
cases.expected: Reported anchored_lapsed; cannotProve external commitment exists after retain-until date.

cases.given: Frozen anchored body; verification time equals retain_until.
cases.expected: Not yet passed: no anchored_lapsed from equality alone.

cases.given: Anchor has seq,rowHash,headAt,algorithm,payloadVersion,capturedAt exactly stored.
cases.operation: Remove each field in turn; freshly sign body.
cases.expected: Proof invalid for each omission; never merely unverifiable.

cases.given: Body signature authentic; anchor rowHash differs from last chain row.
cases.expected: Invalid anchor-to-chain binding.

cases.given: Authentic body.
cases.operation: Drop middle chain row or break prevHash link; freshly sign body.
cases.expected: Invalid chain segment.

cases.given: Pre-column granted TSA token lacks request send time.
cases.expected: unverifiable, request_facts_not_recorded; never valid.

cases.given: Hash-only contiguous chain and anchor verify; no raw row preimage.
cases.expected: unverifiable, preimage_not_exported; cannotProve chained content is decision described.

cases.given: Pre-facts decision; no stored action,policy,model facts; current live tables have values.
cases.expected: Affected sections not_recorded; no backfill from current values.

cases.given: Pre-identity decision.
cases.expected: not_recorded with pre_identity reason; never invent actor chain.

cases.given: Assembly includes an unrecorded member.
cases.expected: aggregate incomplete or unknown; never complete.

cases.given: C03 rendered complete; body freshly signed.
cases.expected: Reject violated invariant; authentic signature cannot make completeness true.

cases.given: Model supplier licence/training source unknown.
cases.expected: Explicit unknown and incomplete composition; no inferred supplier declaration.

cases.given: Training checksum empty, or legacy fnv1a32 checksum.
cases.expected: No SHA-256 hashes entry; incomplete; legacy checksum only as labelled legacy property.

cases.given: Agent belongs to no known use case.
cases.expected: classification unknown, regulait:dataFlow:classification unknown, incomplete composition.

cases.given: Scan engine_run_id null.
cases.expected: Unknown assessor and incomplete composition; no invented engine version/image digest.

cases.given: Signed native v is regulait.ai-bom.v1; outer subject decision-bom.
cases.expected: Refuse mismatched subject/native-v pair.

cases.given: Signed native v is regulait.ai-bom.v1; outer subject ai-bom; independent outer and receipt trust roots supplied.
cases.operation: Verify matching subject and inner evidence.
cases.expected: Subject/v binding valid; other checks remain independently required.

cases.given: Otherwise authentic bundle.
cases.operation: Add audit/rows/1.payload containing raw invocation data.
cases.expected: Refuse forbidden audit preimage; ADR0189 overrides ADR0116 payload inclusion for BOM bundles.

cases.given: Native body and renderings have no email; final README or manifest installId contains synthetic person@example.invalid.
cases.expected: Refuse export naming file/path; whole-bundle scan includes non-body files.

cases.given: Authentic manifest and content.
cases.operation: Add unlisted regular file or remove listed content file.
cases.expected: Refuse manifest membership violation.

cases.given: Authentic manifest.
cases.expected: Refuse non-regular entry.

cases.given: Two distinct decisions with authentic receipts under independently pinned keys; original BOM decision scope retained.
cases.operation: Replace receipt with the other decision receipt and freshly sign BOM.
cases.expected: Invalid or refused decision-to-receipt binding; authentic receipt signature alone does not bind the receipt to this decision.
